verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents an OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages-compatible API that works with third-party OpenAI or Claude SDKs and clients. That is API compatibility, not a LocalAI-published official SDK, so it is an adjacent capability that earns no credit here. No evidence shows LocalAI shipping its own first-party client libraries for any language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
